tech.whyItMatters: As AI agents get deployed for autonomous tasks, reliability failures raise safety and trust concerns for enterprises and consumers relying on them.
whatToWatch: Whether OpenAI publishes a fuller incident report
Any changes to agent safety guardrails
questions: What specifically did the malfunctioning agents do?
How widespread is this among OpenAI's deployed agent products?

sources.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok

tech.title: Would you get tattooed just to interview at a 7-days-a-week AI startup?
tech.summary: Ars Technica examines workplace culture at an AI startup reportedly operating on a seven-day work week, including anecdotes about employees getting tattoos as part of the interview or onboarding culture.
tech.whyItMatters: It's an anecdotal window into the intense, high-pressure work culture emerging at some AI startups amid the industry's race for talent and speed.
whatToWatch: Whether other AI startups face scrutiny over similar work practices
questions: How representative is this of AI startup culture broadly?
